bounds: One synthetic simulator whose rows do not react to orders, made-up parameters and 24 days per regime bound what this study can show. Every value is labelled [observed] (read from a log) or [simulated] (an interactive run in the same simulator); nothing here is an off-policy estimate.
data: synthetic: #102's queue-reactive simulator and regimes, with made-up parameters, on new days generated for this study; no market data. The logs are generated here by #104's behaviours; their rewards are the simulator's consequences, not observed ones

disclosure.not_seen: #280's holdout was never read. None of this study's days, logs or runs exist at the time of this design.
disclosure.reused_choices: as_grid's per-regime points and #102's volatility were selected on #102's days, and the arms' settings are #280's unchanged. Neither was chosen from this study's days.

#102 and #104's holdout values on #102's days 20 to 24 (as_grid -111.59, fixed spread 4 -138.93, maskable PPO about 0 a day)
disclosure.seen_in_attempt_1: Attempt 1 ran at commit 1beac05 and stopped at the compute rule: CQL at alpha 0.1 on standard_eps30 took 405 s against an estimate of 180 s, because its pilot timed 500 gradient steps on one logged day in one process, and because its estimate treated 5 jobs on 4 workers as 1.25 job lengths when whole jobs take 2. No CQL or PPO output of attempt 1 was read, and none is used. Its directory is kept. The holdout was not started.
